remarks: Timeless Colonial Estate: This exquisite five-bedroom, four full and two half-bath Colonial is a testament to charm and grace, set on a sprawling 5.7-acre property complete with a pool and a pool house. Situated just a stone's throw from the prestigious Hunt Club polo fields, this family compound offers the rare blend of ultimate privacy with the convenience of proximity to town, train, and shops. As you pass through the private gates, you'll be greeted by a picturesque view that reflects the estate's storied past and timeless elegance.    Built in 1955 in the style of renowned architect Cameron Clark, this Colonial showcases classic architectural beauty with its distinctive French doors opening to a magnificent backyard. Here, specimen trees, age-old patios, and gracefully aged stone walls and landscaping create a serene environment only time can bestow. This estate is more than just a home; it's a legacy of luxury and refinement, waiting to be cherished by its next owner. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a piece of history and enjoy unparalleled privacy and sophistication. Listing Agent is related to the Seller.
